name: Bench on the living-room side: VIHALS behind a low ÅLHULT bench, BESTÅ credenza on the bottom wall
notes:
No junior chair since 2026-10-26 (Andrew: Maddie, almost 5, sits on a regular chair).
The top side is open to the living room (Andrew, 2026-10-24) as well as the left side to the kitchen, so both 30-inch walkways stay clear (F-42): every floor piece stands at x 30 or more and y 30 or more, nothing hangs on either open side, and rugs run under the walkways.
Bench on the living-room side: a low, backless ÅLHULT bench along the open top side keeps the view from the living room clear at 17 3/4" high, and no chair ever slides back into that walkway. It moves the table 9.75" up the room, which lets the BESTÅ hang low as a credenza on the bottom wall with 37.1" from the table to its doors. Set for six as placed with the table closed: the bench (two), two VIHALS on the bottom side, one at the kitchen end and Maddie's URBAN at the right end.
F-36: 48.5" from the kitchen end to the kitchen line (passing side), 37.1" from the bottom edge to the credenza (45.75" to the wall), 32.25" from the right end to the wall (tight:32.3, the URBAN's end); the bench side needs none. Leaf in (70 7/8"), the table opens 11.8" at each end: 20.4" from its right end to the wall (tight:20.4), so on guest nights slide the opened table right with its kitchen end staying at x 48.5 (8.6" from the other end to the wall, the pendant 11.8" off center that night): two on the bench, three on the bottom side, one at the kitchen end and nobody at the right end, so no chair stands in the kitchen walkway (F-42).
Final audit 2026-10-26: the wall lamps moved 1.4" outward (lamp-1 to x 39.1, lamp-2 to x 98.2), 2.4" from the canvas and from the credenza's ends as in a and e, and the leaf-in seating slides the table instead of putting a chair in the walkway. The HAVSRIS cord is 15' 5" (185"): with the ceiling unmeasured, check for a ceiling box first, and measure the ceiling and find the bottom wall's outlets before buying it (its drop and run need about 171" at a 96" ceiling and about 195" at 108", F-23).

VIHALS closed, across the room against the bench; F-36: 48.5" to the kitchen line (passing side), 37.1" to the credenza, 32.25" from the right end to the wall (tight:32.3); leaf in, 20.4" (tight:20.4)
bottom side, left; 18.6" behind it to the credenza's doors while seated

VARPTROSS above the credenza's left end, centered between the canvas and the credenza's end (2.4" to each; it crowded the canvas at 1" until the final audit 2026-10-26), center about 58" up, plug-in
